'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC female Huanglong tourist accompanied by her companion, '''Gregor'''. They're found by a famous fountain in [[Capitoline Hill City]] that was used in a romance film.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
;(Idle nearby)
:;All right, everyone. This fountain right in front of us is the crown jewel of the square.
:;A critically acclaimed romance film once took a scene here, making this fountain a popular tourist attraction ever since.
:;Oh yeah, that one about the daughter of a Septimont noble falling in love with a foreign reporter, right? I didn't know this was where they filmed it!

;(Day)
:'''Gregor:''' Yes. Up. Down a little, maybe? More to the left. Or is it the right? Is it hands raised or lowered?
:'''Lieselotte:''' Ugh, I told you to do it like in the film. I even showed you the exact scene.
:'''Lieselotte:''' Don't just stand there and shout directions. Do you have the filter on? How's the lighting? Hurry up. There's a line waiting. Don't mess it up!
{{Dialogue End}}
